name: Appelle-moi Rohff
editorial_article: Appelle-moi Rohff is the debut maxi single by French rapper Rohff, released on April 16, 1998, through the labels Espionnage, Phénomène Records, and Chronowax. This foundational release served as a precursor to his debut studio album, Le Code de l'honneur, which followed in 1999. The maxi features production by the influential DJ Mehdi, who provided the soundscapes for both the title track and the B-side, Despee. While both tracks were included on the vinyl release, only the title track was selected for inclusion on the subsequent studio album. The release is notable for a minor orthographic error on the vinyl sleeve, where the title was written with a conjugation mistake. It remains a significant artifact in the early discography of Rohff, marking his entry into the French rap scene during the late 1990s.
editorial_teaser: The debut maxi single from French rapper Rohff, produced by DJ Mehdi and released in 1998 as a precursor to his first studio album.
